label: Agent Orb
description: A glossy, lit gradient sphere: the AI agent as a recurring character. It pops in, flies an arcing path of stops on the words (squash and stretch with its speed, a soft glow trail), lands on each with a squash and a pulse ring, and bobs while it waits. A transparent overlay (full frame, above the content): stops are % of the frame, so it lands on any word or UI element under it. three.js; deterministic under seek.

stops.label: Stops: { at (seconds or "@word"), x (% of frame width), y (% of frame height), size (diameter as a fraction of frame height, optional) }. It arrives at each stop at its time.

size.label: Default diameter as a fraction of frame height

colors.label: Three gradient colors (default brand primary, pink, gold)

arc.label: How far each flight bends off the straight line

glow.label: Glow, trail and ring strength (0 = none)

enter_at.label: When it pops in (seconds or "@word"; default the first stop)
